```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "C:/Users/lon09/New folder")
```

```{r line-chart, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}

files <- list(
  "Direct Q1"   = "Directq1_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Direct Q2"   = "Directq2_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Direct Q3"   = "Directq3_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Direct Q4"   = "Directq4_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Direct Q5"   = "Directq5_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Direct Q6"   = "Directq6_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Indirect Q1" = "Indirectq1_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Indirect Q2" = "Indirectq2_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Indirect Q3" = "Indirectq3_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Indirect Q4" = "Indirectq4_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Indirect Q5" = "Indirectq5_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Indirect Q6" = "Indirectq6_cosine_evaluation.csv"
)

version_names <- c("NonChunking", "EqualChunking", "ManualChunkingOverlap",
                   "LangChain", "LangChainOverlap")

results <- data.frame()

for (question_name in names(files)) {
  file_path <- files[[question_name]]

  df <- read.csv(file_path)


  mean_row <- df[trimws(tolower(df$Run.time)) == "mean", ]

  colnames(mean_row) <- c("Run", version_names)

  row <- data.frame(
    Question = question_name,
    Version  = version_names,
    Mean     = as.numeric(mean_row[1, version_names])
  )
  results <- rbind(results, row)
}

results$Question <- factor(results$Question, levels = names(files))
results$Version  <- factor(results$Version,  levels = version_names)

ggplot(results, aes(x = Question, y = Mean, color = Version, group = Version)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Cosine Similarity Across All 12 Questions",
    x     = "Question",
    y     = "Mean Cosine Similarity Score",
    color = "Version"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))
```
